nodes.description: Total minted token supply tracked by the KAA contract; initialized to 0 and incremented in processFunding.
Owner address of the Ownable/Pausable inheritance chain; set from msg.sender in the constructor and mutated by ownership functions.
Pausable flag controlling whenNotPaused guarded token operations.
Inner lock baseline timestamp (1629216000) used to compute platform/team release epochs.
Outer lock baseline timestamp (1566057600) used to compute strategic partner unlock epochs.
Unlock epoch length in seconds (2592000 = 30 days) used as divisor for epoch computation.
Amount already withdrawn from the platform funding bucket.
Amount released per epoch for the platform funding bucket.
Amount already withdrawn from the team keeping bucket.
Amount released per epoch for the team keeping bucket.
Amount already distributed to strategic partners.
Total amount already withdrawn through the common withdrawal path.
Mapping of strategic partner address to locked token amount used to restrict transfers.
ERC20 balance mapping address => amount.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
KAA constructor initializing supply counters, epoch releases and lock timestamps.
Internal unified token distribution function that mints into a receiver balance and emits Transfer.
Owner-only common withdrawal used for sharing and mining rewards.
Owner-only withdrawal from the platform funding bucket gated by canPlatformFundingWithdraw.
Owner-only withdrawal from the team keeping bucket gated by canTeamKeepingWithdraw.
Owner-only distribution to a strategic partner that also records a locked amount.
View computing the currently withdrawable platform funding amount from timestamps and past withdrawals.
View computing the currently withdrawable team keeping amount from timestamps and past withdrawals.
View computing the still-locked amount for a strategic partner based on remaining epochs.
View returning the current block timestamp via now.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
ERC20 transfer that first enforces the strategic partner lock amount via clacCooperateNeedLockAmount.
ERC20 balance query returning balances[_owner].
ERC20 transferFrom that enforces the lock amount for the source account and reduces allowance.
ERC20 approve that writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
ERC20 allowance query returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Owner-only function setting owner to address(0).
Owner-only entry point delegating to _transferOwnership.

onlyOwner modifier enforcing the access control requirement on privileged entry points.
External caller address used for ownership, withdrawal receivers and allowance accounting.
Block timestamp consumed through now inside queryNow and the release schedule computations.
Assignment owner = msg.sender performed in the constructor.
